Refund_not_showing_up: a refund the customer was promised has not appeared in their account yet
activate_my_card: how to activate a new card, or the card cannot be activated
age_limit: minimum age to open or use an account, accounts for children
apple_pay_or_google_pay: using Apple Pay, Google Pay or a smartwatch with the card or to top up
atm_support: which ATMs or cash machines accept the card
automatic_top_up: setting up or using automatic top-ups (auto top-up)
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: money sent by bank transfer has arrived but the balance has not updated
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: a cheque or cash deposit is not yet reflected in the balance
beneficiary_not_allowed: cannot add a beneficiary or payee, or transfers to a beneficiary are blocked
cancel_transfer: wants to cancel or reverse a transfer that was just made
card_about_to_expire: the card is expiring soon and the customer asks about a replacement
card_acceptance: where, in which shops or merchants, the card can be used
card_arrival: an ordered card has not arrived yet
card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery takes or requesting a specific delivery date
card_linking: linking or re-adding an existing or found card to the app
card_not_working: the card does not work in general, without a specific declined payment
card_payment_fee_charged: an unexpected fee was charged on a card payment
card_payment_not_recognised: a card payment on the statement the customer did not make or does not recognise
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: a card payment abroad used a wrong or bad exchange rate
card_swallowed: an ATM kept or swallowed the card
cash_withdrawal_charge: a fee was charged for a cash withdrawal
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: a cash withdrawal appears that the customer did not make
change_pin: how to change the card PIN
compromised_card: the card may be compromised or used fraudulently by someone else
country_support: which countries the bank or its cards are available or supported in
declined_card_payment: a card payment at a shop or online was declined
declined_cash_withdrawal: a cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: a direct debit payment the customer does not recognise
disposable_card_limits: limits or restrictions on disposable virtual cards
edit_personal_details: changing personal details such as name, address or phone number
exchange_rate: what exchange rate is used or what money is worth in another currency
exchange_via_app: how to exchange between currencies in the app
extra_charge_on_statement: an unexplained extra charge or fee appears on the statement
failed_transfer: a transfer failed or did not go through
fiat_currency_support: which currencies the account can hold or exchange
get_disposable_virtual_card: how to get a disposable virtual card or what it is for
get_physical_card: receiving the physical card and its PIN for the first time
getting_spare_card: ordering an additional or spare card
getting_virtual_card: how to order or get a virtual card
lost_or_stolen_card: the card was lost or stolen
lost_or_stolen_phone: the phone with the banking app was lost or stolen
order_physical_card: ordering a physical card, its cost or delivery options
passcode_forgotten: forgot the app passcode or password
pending_card_payment: a card payment is still showing as pending
pending_cash_withdrawal: a cash withdrawal is still showing as pending
pending_top_up: a top-up is still pending or taking long to go through
pending_transfer: an outgoing transfer is still pending
pin_blocked: the PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts
receiving_money: how to receive money or salary into the account
request_refund: how to request or get a refund for a purchase
reverted_card_payment?: a card payment was reverted or returned
supported_cards_and_currencies: which cards or currencies can be used to add money or top up
terminate_account: close, delete or deactivate the account
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: fees for topping up by bank transfer
top_up_by_card_charge: fees for topping up with a card
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: topping up the account with cash or a cheque
top_up_failed: a top-up attempt failed or did not work
top_up_limits: maximum amount or number of top-ups allowed
top_up_reverted: a top-up was reversed, cancelled or the money disappeared
topping_up_by_card: a top-up made with a card is missing or how to top up by card
transaction_charged_twice: the same transaction was charged twice or duplicated
transfer_fee_charged: a fee was charged for making a transfer
transfer_into_account: how to transfer money into the account
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: the recipient has not received a transfer that was sent
transfer_timing: how long a transfer takes to arrive
unable_to_verify_identity: the customer tried but could not complete identity verification
verify_my_identity: how to verify identity and what documents are needed
verify_source_of_funds: the bank asks where the money comes from (source of funds)
verify_top_up: how to verify a top-up or find the verification code
virtual_card_not_working: the virtual card does not work
visa_or_mastercard: whether the card is Visa or Mastercard
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: the ATM dispensed less or a different amount of cash than requested
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: a cash withdrawal abroad used a wrong exchange rate
